intro.p1:
Picture yourself arriving at an airport abroad.
You've collected your bags, cleared customs, and now you see it: "A massive queue at the SIM card counter".
intro.p2:
After a long flight, you're tired, dragging luggage, waiting in line, handing your phone to a stranger to swap the SIM...
Then worrying about losing that tiny card and having to swap it back when you get home.

"There has to be a better way to stay connected."
intro.p3:
"Airalo", the world's first eSIM marketplace app, is that better way.
With Airalo, you can connect to the internet the moment your plane touches down—even before the seatbelt sign turns off.

whatIsEsim.title: What is an "eSIM"?
whatIsEsim.desc:
eSIM is a digital SIM card embedded in your phone.
No need to insert a plastic card; just scan a QR code (or use an app) to add a data plan.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.q1: Q. Does my phone support it?
faq.a1: iPhone XR/XS and later basically support it. Recent Androids (Pixel, Galaxy) too. You can check compatibility within the app.
faq.q2: Q. Can I receive calls on my home number?
faq.a2: Yes. Set your home SIM as "Primary" (for calls) and Airalo for "Mobile Data". You keep your number for calls/SMS while using cheap data abroad.
faq.a3: Most plans support it (check plan details). You can work connecting your laptop or tablet.
